title: The Sky Lanterns
hook: It stands over us. Don't move.
synopsis: The Hush is faster over the high meadow. The wagon is full of lanterns for Lantern Town, and Rook lets them all go.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: The lamps went out. It's here! Full steam!
It's coming over the hill. Hold the bar!
It's gaining on us! Come on, old girl!
The festival lanterns! I have an idea.
Light them all. Let them go!
Shine bright, little lights. Go high!
It can't fly. It can't reach them.
It sees us! Lights on! Full steam!
Over the old bridge! Go, go!
Lantern Town! Sorry, no lanterns this year.
It will be back. Hold the bar.
